description.value: The Vodka Ice Bar is a seasonal, immersive vodka-tasting experience tucked inside Lizard Creek Lodge, a ski-in ski-out resort at Fernie Alpine Resort. Guests don Helly Hansen parkas to sample vodkas from around the world — including Canadian-made Crystal Head Vodka — in a sub-zero environment. It is part of a full-service mountain lodge that also includes a restaurant, spa, pool, and hot tubs.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for https://lizardcreek.com/ice-bar/ confirms this is a real seasonal vodka-tasting bar located within Lizard Creek Lodge at Fernie Alpine Resort, matching the OSM address at 5346 Highline Drive. The contact page explicitly shows 'Ice Bar Currently Mon - Sun Closed', consistent with the OSM 'Seasonal' opening_hours tag, indicating an out-of-season closure rather than permanent closure. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM name is 'Vodka Ice Bar' but the website refers to it simply as 'Ice Bar' — minor name mismatch.
Ice Bar is currently showing as 'Mon - Sun Closed' on the lodge contact page, consistent with seasonal (ski-season) operation. Not permanently closed.
Phone number supplied (1-877-228-1948) is the lodge-wide reservations line, not a direct bar number; OSM had no phone on record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible seasonal bar within an established lodge at Fernie Alpine Resort. Currently closed for the season but not permanently closed; the lodge and its other amenities remain operational.
enrichment_extras.notes: The bar is seasonal and appears to operate during ski season only. Cycling visitors should confirm the bar is open before visiting, as it is not a year-round operation.

wow_evidence: seasonal, immersive vodka-tasting experience tucked inside Lizard Creek Lodge
